At the Annual Meeting of Shareowners of Kennametal Inc. (the "Company") on October 27, 2026, the Company's Shareowners voted on the election of nine directors with terms to expire in 2027, the ratification of the selection of PricewaterhouseCoopers LLP as the Company's independent registered public accounting firm for the fiscal year ending June 30, 2027 and an advisory vote on executive compensation. The 69,776,589 shares present in person or represented by proxy at the meeting were voted as described below. I. The nine directors listed below were elected to serve as directors until the next annual meeting of Shareowners in 2027 and until their successors are duly elected and qualified by the following vote: For Withheld Broker Non-Votes Joseph Alvarado 59,961,025 5,598,847 4,216,717 Shelley Bausch 65,405,831 154,041 4,216,717 Sanjay Chowbey 65,382,330 177,542 4,216,717 Douglas T.
